text:
alex: heads-up — we saw ~2% of requests falling back to generic-policy even though their route should match prioritizer v3
mira: hmm, where are we seeing the fallbacks? logs or decision traces?
dan: decision-log sampling was at 1% in prod. grabbed a few examples and most are no-op fallbacks with reason=RULE_EVAL_SKIPPED
alex: exact message: "skipped rule eval: header-mismatch (case-sensitive)" — but clients send mixed-case custom headers, we normalize them in the router normally
sam: can you dump the raw headers from a failing trace? we might be stripping them at the LB layer
alex: pasted one sample below (redacted):
```
x-customer-id: 1234
X-Feature-Flag: beta
Host: api.redwood.ai
```
mira: router code checks headers with `req.headers['x-feature-flag']` (lowercase). Prioritizer v3 uses `hasHeaderExact('X-Feature-Flag')` for historical reasons — that would skip
dan: ugh. that explains RULE_EVAL_SKIPPED. why did this only show up as 2%?
sam: because decision-log sampling was low + we only started returning the new prioritizer in canary on ~10% of traffic, so overlap is small
alex: proposal: add a fallback normalizer in the prioritizer that lowercases header keys before eval, and add an opt-out for rules that intentionally need case-preserved headers
mira: agree. short term we should increase decision-log sampling to 10% for the problematic route so we can confirm impact
deploy-bot: deploy queued: prioritizer/normalize-headers patch -> staging at 1771123490
dan: also we should surface this in console: the rule evaluation trace should show the exact header key used and the matched predicate (or lack thereof). right now traces only show predicate ids
sam: +1, without predicate inputs it's hard to debug. UX ask: show input snapshot (headers, path, method) when you click a decision node
alex: i can do the normalize patch and add a verbose trace flag. who owns turning sampling up in prod?
mira: infra-team owns sampling toggles. pinging them now — @infra-team please bump route `customer-priority` decision-log-sample to 10% for the next 30m
alex: infra-team responded in internal ticket, will do 1771123505
dan: once sampling is up, can we run a quick KQL query to count RULE_EVAL_SKIPPED by reason and header pattern?
sam: yes, I'll run: `index=decision-logs env=prod route=customer-priority | stats count by skip_reason, headers.x-feature-flag`
mira: follow-up action list: 1) patch prioritizer to normalize headers (alex) 2) add input snapshot to decision trace (dan) 3) increase sampling to 10% for 30m (infra) 4) run post-change KQL and validate (sam)
alex: timeline: patch and staging deploy now, prod patch hold until infra confirms sampling is up and we have test traces
mira: small UX note: when we add input snapshot, let's make it redact user tokens automatically (do not show Authorization or Cookies in traces)
dan: agreed. also let's make the console highlight when sampled traces exist vs when there are none (little badge)
sam: after we confirm fix, we should roll a console alert template so SRE oncall gets notified if skip rates >0.5% for 15m
alex: thanks team — I'll follow up with PR link and staging logs once deploy finishes
deploy-bot: deploy success: prioritizer/normalize-headers -> staging at 1771123512
mira: saw staging traces with normalized keys, prioritizer matched as expected on a few samples
dan: infra: sampling increased to 10% at 1771123505 and will auto-reset in 30m
sam: running KQL now, preliminary: skip_reason=RULE_EVAL_SKIPPED due to header-mismatch dropped from 1200/hr to ~10/hr in sampled logs
alex: sounds good. leaving this thread open until prod verify and console UI changes are tracked in the UX ticket
mira: thanks — moving action items into the eng-platform board
